name: Histc

x.description: Input tensor, any shape (1D-2D). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

min.description: float, lower end of the range (inclusive).

max.description: float, upper end of the range (inclusive).

hist.description: Histogram tensor of shape (bins,), dtype float32 (histc always returns float32).

description:
Histc: Computes the histogram of a tensor.

torch.histc = histc(input, bins=100, min=0, max=0, *, out=None) -> Tensor

The elements are sorted into equal width bins between min and max. If min and max are both zero, the minimum and maximum values of the data are used.

Elements lower than min and higher than max and NaN elements are ignored.

Args:
    input (Tensor): the input tensor.
    bins (int): number of histogram bins.
    min (Scalar): lower end of the range (inclusive).
    max (Scalar): upper end of the range (inclusive).

Keyword args:
    out (Tensor, optional): the output tensor.

Example:
    >>> torch.histc(torch.tensor([1., 2, 1]), bins=4, min=0, max=3)
    tensor([0., 2., 1., 0.])

Returns: Tensor of shape (bins,), dtype float32.
